Trumpler (p. 175, 1930): “NGC 6216 – Melotte 152 should be identified with this [NGC 6216] and not with NGC 6222.” Trumpler lists 3.8 arc minutes angular diameter for NGC 6216. Collinder (1931, p. B37) notes that NGC 6222 (Mel. 152) and NGC 6216 are “probably one and the same.”  Archinal and Hynes (2003, pp. 175-176) conclude that NGC 6222 is an unidentifiable cluster of 20’ diameter observed by Herschel, but they agree with Trumpler and Collinder that NGC 6216 is the only cluster matching the location and dimensions recorded by all: from Herschel to Melotte to Trumpler and Collinder.
